title: 14 Sharaab khano ki yakja mila ke laa sharaabe ishqe ali
body:
14 Sharaab khano ki yakja mila ke laa
Aye umr e jaodaan mera saagar utha ke laa
<<DIVIDER>>
Jam e wila mai zehr e adadat na ghool dein
Is maye ko dushmano ki nazar se bacha ke laa
<<DIVIDER>>
Peena hai maye ghadeer ki kaabe mai beth ker
Jo hajiyon mai rind hain inko bula ke la
<<DIVIDER>>
Le chal najaf ko raksh e muqadar kisi tarah
Ik martaba mujhe meri jannat dikha ke laa
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Jo Ali Ali ke tarane pe mahtaraz
Unko Dil e rasool ki dharkan suna ke laa
<<DIVIDER>>
Gar ho Ali ki nend ki meraj dekhna
Hijrat ki shab ki ankh se kajal chura ke laa
<<DIVIDER>>
Ae jibrail aye hain balein pe bu turab
Jaa jald jake arsh se kursi utha ke laa
<<DIVIDER>>
Wais ko jam e midhat e haider pila saroosh
Le jaa is admi ko bhi insan bana ke laa
author: Mir Hassan Mir
